name: GM Signature For Elementor Forms
author: theme funda

sections.description:
Easily add digital signature fields to your Elementor forms. Capture legally binding e-signatures directly on your website. Fast, secure, and fully responsive!

Features

  • Adds a signature field to Elementor Forms
  • Customizable pen and background color
  • Mobile-friendly and touch support
  • Saves signature as an image (Base64)

Usage

  1. Edit a page with Elementor.
  2. Add or edit a Form widget.
  3. Use the new Signature field in the form fields list.
  4. Customize the pen color, background, width, and height from the field settings.
  5. Publish the page and collect signatures!
sections.installation:
Upload via WordPress Dashboard

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  4. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now.
  5. Click Activate after installation.

Upload via FTP

  1. Unzip the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Upload the extracted folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory using FTP.
  3. Go to your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Navigate to Plugins and click Activate next to “Signature Field for Elementor Forms”.
